title: 40 people told ICIG of reverse engineering program

tellings.quote: you have to be pretty darn weird to go to the ICIG, Inspector General, and say I was part of a I was part of a reverse engineering program. That's that's right. 40 people have done allegedly, right?

plain: About 40 people have allegedly gone to the ICIG, the inspector general who acts as internal watchdog for the US intelligence agencies, to say they took part in a reverse engineering program, meaning secret work to take apart recovered craft not made by humans and learn how they work. Jesse Michels says this himself, adding that it is alleged, during a debate with a UFO skeptic named Mick West. His argument is that you would have to be very strange to make such a claim to an inspector general if it were not true.
